entries.title: Packet Highway Through Transparent Routers
entries.description: A stream of glowing spheres (data packets) of different colors flows along curved transparent tubes between box-shaped routers, where packets queue, split, merge, and sometimes collide or get dropped with fading trails and labels showing their IDs.

entries.title: 3D Network Topology with Congestion Visualization
entries.description: A 3D lattice of stationary nodes (small labeled cubes) connected by semi-transparent edges carries packets (colored arrows) that move, slow down in congested links (color-shifting to red), reroute around failures, and leave faint trails that gradually dissipate.

entries.title: Undersea Fiber Cable Packet Tunnel
entries.description: A long, semi-transparent undersea cable tube stretches between two shore stations on a light seabed, with packets as luminous pulses racing inside, reflecting off in-line repeaters, sometimes fragmenting on errors and reassembling at the endpoints, with tiny particle sparks for bit flips.

entries.title: Packet Swarm Through a Data Center Rack Maze

entries.title: 3D Visualization of Packet Fragmentation and Reassembly
entries.description: Large rectangular “messages” enter a narrow transparent tunnel and split into smaller packet bricks that fly in staggered order, some getting lost and leaving ghost trails, while a reassembly buffer box at the far end gradually reconstructs the original message and discards timeouts.

entries.title: Packet Routing in a 3D Mesh of Switches

entries.title: Packet Flood Attack and Defense Visualization
